verdict: Dr. Ayaz dresses like he personally calculates your GPA on an abacus just to ensure you miss honors by one decimal point.
detailedQuote: The faded grey button-down screams 'I haven't revised my syllabus since the mid-2000s,' while those gigantic wire aviators exist solely to magnify his complete apathy during mandatory office hours. If tenure-track depression had a default avatar fit, this soul-crushing ensemble would be it.

inventory.name: Faded Grey Button-Down Shirt of Eternal Monotone
inventory.description: A washed-out, completely unseasoned grey shirt that looks like it was harvested directly from a fluorescent-lit department meeting and has never once encountered an iron.

inventory.name: Over-Sized Clear Wire Aviator Glasses
inventory.description: Vintage-styled transparent spectacles large enough to double as windshields, engineered specifically to reflect the despair of students receiving an unannounced quiz.
